system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Calculates eligible loan amount based on project type, cost, and farmer's repayment capacity. For your information, my project_cost is dummy_project_cost_7697, my project_type is dummy_project_type_9940.

function.name: nabard_calculate_loan_amount
function.description: Calculates eligible loan amount based on project type, cost, and farmer's repayment capacity. Returns maximum eligible amount and indicative EMI. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if project type unsupported or cost is unrealistic.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
